target_utility.name: ShrinkMyPhoto
target_utility.mission: Sovereign client-side photo compression with precision target KB sizing and zero cloud data leaks.

core_primitives: DataView header inspection (magic bytes for PNG, WebP, JPEG)

algorithm.type: Coupled Geometric Resizing + Quality Bisection Search
algorithm.search_budget: Up to 8 dimension passes x 7 quality bisection steps (max 56 encodes)

unmet_user_needs.insight: Government portals, visa agencies (US DV Lottery, Schengen, Indian Visa), job boards (Workday, Taleo), and university forms mandate strict caps (e.g. <240KB, <200KB, <50KB). Existing tools only give arbitrary quality % sliders, forcing users into 5-10 frustrating upload/download iterations.

Users compressing driver licenses, passport scans, tax slips, or medical cards are terrified of cloud upload leaks. IT/dev teams handling client brand assets cannot violate NDAs by uploading to TinyPNG.
Modern smartphones shoot 6MB to 16MB photos by default. Incumbent 5MB limits (TinyPNG) outright reject ordinary phone photos before any compression can begin.

Users taking screenshots with Windows Snipping Tool (Win+Shift+S) or copying web images want to paste directly into the compressor and copy the compressed result directly back to Slack/email without saving junk files to disk.

sovereign_unfair_advantage.zero_cloud_leak: Zero bytes transferred over the network. 100% processed via WebAssembly/Canvas in browser memory. Verifiable by inspecting DevTools Network tab.
sovereign_unfair_advantage.infinite_scalability: Zero server compute costs. $0 infrastructure overhead allows forever-free, unlimited local compression without ads or subscriptions.
sovereign_unfair_advantage.precision_bisection_engine: Binary search algorithm mathematical convergence to <= target KB with maximum possible visual fidelity and resolution retention.
sovereign_unfair_advantage.instant_latency: No network round-trip, no upload queues, no server processing delays.

killer_feature_disruption_roadmap.name: Full Clipboard Ingestion & Export
killer_feature_disruption_roadmap.description: Global Ctrl+V / Paste listener reading images directly from system clipboard (e.g. Snipping Tool), plus a 'Copy Image to Clipboard' button using navigator.clipboard.write([new ClipboardItem()]) for immediate pasting into Slack/Discord/Email without saving to disk.

killer_feature_disruption_roadmap.name: Bureaucratic & Practical Target KB Presets
killer_feature_disruption_roadmap.description: One-click preset chips: 'Visa / Passport (< 200 KB)', 'Gov Portal / ID (< 100 KB)', 'Fast Web Hero (< 150 KB)', 'Email Friendly (< 500 KB)', 'Discord Free Tier (< 10 MB)'.

killer_feature_disruption_roadmap.name: Side-by-Side Zoom & Split Compare
killer_feature_disruption_roadmap.description: Split comparison slider showing original vs compressed image at 100% pixel scale so users can verify text readability and face sharpness before saving.

killer_feature_disruption_roadmap.name: Forensic EXIF / GPS Scrubbing Indicator
killer_feature_disruption_roadmap.description: Visual confirmation badge verifying that sensitive GPS coordinates, camera serial numbers, and personal timestamps have been cleanly expunged upon canvas re-encoding.

killer_feature_disruption_roadmap.name: Air-Gapped Offline PWA
killer_feature_disruption_roadmap.description: Service worker caching enabling offline functionality on flights, secure government labs, or air-gapped terminals with zero connectivity.
